line.a_piknik.text: What a lovely day! Let's have a picnic on the meadow, on the other side of the brook.

line.a_most.text: The bridge is far away, over there. Let's make our own little bridge here, from a plank!

line.a_deski.text: Two planks are lying on the grass. We need a long one, so it reaches the other bank.

line.a_ta.text: This one is longer! Look, it reaches all the way there, further than that one.

line.a_wpadla.text: Oh no! The plank didn't reach and fell into the water. It was too short!

line.a_wylowilem.text: Never mind, I fished it out. But how can we tell which plank is longer?

line.a_metoda.text: That plank only lay further out, so it looked longer. To compare length, put the planks side by side from one line.

line.a_przeciagnij.text: Drag both planks to the line, so they start in the same place.

line.a_teraz_widac.text: The one whose end is further from the line is longer. Which plank is longer? Point to it.

line.a_ta_krotsza.text: This plank ends sooner, it is shorter. Which one reaches further from the line?

line.a_dluzsza.text: This one is longer! And that one is shorter. Now I can see it.

line.a_siega.text: The long plank reaches the other bank. We have a bridge!

line.a_przeszlismy.text: We crossed to the other side! Hooray, to the meadow!

line.b_zimno.text: Brr, it's so windy! My scarf is too short, I can't wrap it around my neck.

line.b_szaliki.text: I have another scarf. Put both from the line and we'll see which one is longer.

line.b_ktory.text: Which scarf is longer? Point to it, and Squirrel will put it on.

line.b_za_krotki.text: That is the short scarf, it won't wrap around. Point to the longer one.

line.b_cieplo.text: The long scarf wraps all around! Now I'm warm.

line.b_wyscig.text: Look, the snails are racing to the flower! Point to a snail to cheer it on.

line.b_meta.text: It's at the finish! Bravo, little snail!

line.b_piknik.text: And now the picnic! We have one long baguette, enough for everybody.

line.b_do_domu.text: Yum! And after the picnic we go back home.

line.p_start.text: Let's play long and short! I have five games.

line.p_wstazki.text: The ribbons are lying every which way. Put them from the line to compare them.

line.p_dluzsza.text: Which ribbon is longer? Point to it.

line.p_dluzsza_nie.text: This ribbon is shorter. Point to the one that reaches further from the line.

line.p_najkrotsza.text: Three planks start at the line. Which one is the shortest? Point to it.

line.p_najkrotsza_nie.text: This plank is longer. We are looking for the one that ends soonest.

line.p_najkrotsza_ok.text: Yes! That is the shortest plank.

line.p_weze.text: I drew two snakes. Which snake is longer? Point to it.

line.p_weze_nie.text: This snake is shorter. Which one goes on longer?

line.p_cien_dlugi.text: This is the shadow of the long scarf. Which scarf is it? Point to it.

line.p_cien_krotki.text: This is the shadow of the short scarf. Which scarf is it? Point to it.

line.p_cien_nie.text: Look at the shadow again. Is it long or short?

line.p_cien_ok.text: Yes! The shadow fits the scarf.

line.p_lap.text: Ribbons are popping up! Catch the long ribbon, point to it.

line.p_lap_ok.text: Caught! You're as quick as the wind.

line.d_wieszaki.text: We're back home. Two scarves hang on the hooks: a long one and a short one. Whose is which?

line.d_porownaj.text: First let's compare the scarves. Put them from the line.

line.d_daj.text: The long scarf is for me, because I'm tall, and the short one for little Squirrel. Drag each scarf to the right friend.

line.d_nie_ten.text: That scarf is for someone else. The long one for Fox, the short one for Squirrel.

line.d_pasuje.text: Everyone has a scarf that is just right!

line.d_rodzice.text: Compare shoelaces or spaghetti with your parents. Remember: always from one line!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for the picnic together! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the snail from the race on the meadow. We got it when we built a bridge and compared what is long and what is short.

line.a_konce.text: Now look where each plank ends. I'm marking the ends.

line.d_klocki.text: At home we'll measure the scarves another way: with blocks. I'll lay blocks along the scarf, and you count them.

line.d_wiecej_klockow.text: The long scarf took more blocks. The more blocks, the longer it is!

line.d_dluga1.text: My scarf is one block long!

line.d_dluga2.text: My scarf is two blocks long!

line.d_dluga3.text: My scarf is three blocks long!

line.d_dluga4.text: My scarf is four blocks long!

line.d_dluga5.text: My scarf is five blocks long!

line.d_dluga6.text: My scarf is six blocks long!

line.d_dluga7.text: My scarf is seven blocks long!

line.k_kuchnia.text: And now to the kitchen! We'll make pasta for dinner.

line.k_umowa.text: Let's agree: we'll lay all the pasta from one line and see which is the longest and which the shortest. Drag each piece to the line.

line.k_najdluzszy.text: Which pasta is the longest? Point to it.

line.k_najdluzszy_nie.text: Look whose end is furthest from the line.

line.k_najkrotszy.text: And which is the shortest? Point to it.

line.k_najkrotszy_nie.text: Look for the one whose end is closest to the line.

line.k_pomieszajmy.text: I've got an idea! Let's mix the longest with the shortest. Everyone gets their own!

line.k_pyszne.text: Long and short in one pot. Yummy!
